upstream.tagKind: lightweight (git ls-remote --tags shows no peeled ^{} entry)

license.spdxNote: The file's own abbreviation is MSCL-1.0-GPL (Monospace Sustainable Core License 1.0 with a GPL-3.0 grant of future license on the 4th anniversary of each version's release); it is not an SPDX-listed id. package.json says "SEE LICENSE IN license". Directus 11.x and earlier used BSL-1.1; 12.4.1 does not.
license.testingConditions: Permitted Purpose = any purpose other than a Competing Use (making the Software available to a party that competes with the Licensor's paid offerings of the Software itself). Local, disposable, internal testing is a Permitted Purpose. Limitation: do not move/change/disable/circumvent license-key functionality or modify license-key-protected portions; this campaign does not (no license key configured, no source modified). Redistribution (e.g. packaging Directus inside X-trace artifacts) must carry the license text and impose no extra restrictions; X-trace does not redistribute Directus.

runtime.database: PostgreSQL 18.3 (docker image postgres:18.3, tmpfs data, reset per run)
runtime.httpStack: Express 4.22.3 (pnpm catalog) over node:http createServer (api/src/server.ts createServer -> createApp)
runtime.otherInterfaces: GraphQL (graphql-compose) and WebSocket (ws/graphql-ws) mounted on the same server; not exercised
runtime.moduleSystem: ESM (TypeScript compiled by tsdown to api/dist)

buildAdaptations: Install limited with pnpm --filter to @directus/api and directus (no app/ SPA build); runs in the ephemeral Docker image with pnpm store and corepack home on the bind-mounted checkout (.xtrace-* dirs, git-excluded). No upstream source file is modified.
configAdaptations: SERVE_APP=false (the Vue admin app is not built); all /server, /auth, /items, /collections API routes are unaffected.

run.entrypointDocker: node api/dist/cli/run.js bootstrap && node api/dist/cli/run.js start (cwd = checkout root; same as `directus bootstrap` / `directus start`)
run.readiness: GET /server/ping == 200 (/server/health requires an admin token in v12.4.1) (necessary, never sufficient)

expectedSeams: DB select on directus_users via knex/pg
6 concurrent POST + 18 concurrent GET; each recording must contain only its own request/route/item and its own pg statements (no cross association)
express root with no matched route (not-found handler)
body-parser error path on malformed JSON

knownLimits: No outbound/failure scenario yet: Directus Flows 'Webhook / Request URL' operation to a deterministic local dependency server is present upstream but not exercised in this preparation (requires IMPORT_IP_DENY_LIST relaxation; see report).
GraphQL, websockets, file uploads, extensions are not exercised.
Upstream test suites were not run (baseline harness only).

instrumented.status: NOT RUN (preparation only). Documented for the later packaged-candidate run.
instrumented.xtraceVersionAtPreparation: slice/v001-node-capture 09aba20 provides only the node:http server request root (adapters/node/packages/adapter-core/src/http-capture.cts); Express/Nest/Fastify framework modules and DB-driver seams required by ADR 0005 are not present on that branch, so only the HTTP-root assertions below are currently satisfiable; the framework/DB rows become required as those modules land.
procedure: 1. node harness/run.mjs prepare|create+build (once) -> immutable pinned workspace.

2. Start PostgreSQL (or seed SQLite) fresh exactly as in the baseline (harness reset), then launch the app with the packaged `xtrace` as the process launcher inside the same linux/arm64 Docker image (or on the host with the same Node major) instead of plain `node`.
3. Run the same scenarios (same harness code, same request bodies); compare each scenario's semanticEffectFingerprint with baseline-<n>/scenarios.json; any difference fails the scenario.

4. Query X-trace (CLI/API/browser) for the recording of each request and assert handler/intermediate/DB/outcome rows listed in `scenarios[].expectedSeams`, with wrong-association checks for `concurrent-writes-and-reads` (every recording holds only its own route params, response and DB statements).

5. Stop/restart X-trace, reopen persisted captures in the packaged browser; privacy canaries (synthetic secrets in request bodies, headers, cookies, DB values) must not appear in wire/logs/storage/API/exports/diagnostics; measure overhead (baseline vs instrumented p50/p95 and throughput over repeated runs).
instrumented.launcher: xtrace run -- node api/dist/cli/run.js start   (cwd = checkout root, after an uninstrumented `node api/dist/cli/run.js bootstrap`; `pnpm --filter directus start`/`npx directus start` are launcher-propagation variants; ESM entry => registerHooks/--import path of the Node adapter must handle ESM + the isolated-vm worker threads).

seamsByLayer.express: Express 4.22.3 app from createApp(): route templates (/items/:collection/:pk, /auth/login, /collections, /users/me), middleware order (authenticate, sanitize query, validate, respond), error handler (required)
seamsByLayer.db: knex 3.1.0 -> pg Client.query (SQL text sanitized, binds excluded; DDL for collection creation included)
seamsByLayer.outcome: HTTP status + Directus error code (FORBIDDEN, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, FAILED_VALIDATION, ROUTE_NOT_FOUND)

ledger.receiptShape: tools/release/check_ledger.py (slice/v001-control-admission) validate_receipt/_validate_special: schemaVersion 1; requirementId; result 'passed'; candidateSha == exact candidate; build{id,sourceSha,artifactSetSha256} bound to the accepted logical release build; artifacts[] {path,sha256} (packaged xtrace artifacts in the accepted set); evidence[] {path,sha256}; checks[] each {status:'passed', reached:true}; kind 'campaign'; attestation{upstream{canonicalUrl (https), sha (40-hex), stableTag}, scenarios[>=5]{name, baseline{path,sha256}, instrumented{path,sha256}, browser{path,sha256}, privacy{path,sha256}, overhead{path,sha256}, semanticEffectFingerprint (64-hex) == instrumentedSemanticEffectFingerprint}, artifacts[]}; signatures[] containing a trusted 'campaign-runner' role signature.
ledger.fromThisPreparation: baseline-<n>/scenario-index.json (written by lib/export-scenarios.mjs) supplies, per scenario, name, baseline{path,sha256} and the 64-hex semanticEffectFingerprint; the instrumented run must reproduce each fingerprint exactly and write instrumentedSemanticEffectFingerprint, instrumented/browser/privacy/overhead evidence files. Skipped, unreached or synthetic assertions never count.
